name: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt

status.en: 335 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 28% fewer than the week before, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.
status.nb: 335 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 28 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Hyderabad.

summary.en: Security forces in Man Kashmir continued joint reviews by the DGP and GOC of XV Corps, held an anti-fidayeen mock drill in Bandipora and investigated the death of a JCO, while civilian casualties occurred from a dumper accident, a truck crash and a sand-mound collapse. In Manipur the Assam Rifles DG inspected border fencing and joint grids, seized weapons from a Kuki-Zo insurgent camp and the Kuki-Zo Council warned of stronger political measures including withdrawing MLAs. The Naga council organized a mega rally demanding the SoO pact be scrapped. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker i Man Kashmir fortsatte felles gjennomganger av DGP og GOC for XV Corps, holdt en anti-fidayeen øvelsesøvelse i Bandipora og etterforsket dødsfallet til en JCO, mens sivile ble drept i en dumperulykke, en lastebilkrasj og et sammenras av en sandhaug. I Manipur inspiserte Assam Rifles DG grensegjerdet og felles nett, beslagla våpen fra en Kuki-Zo-opprørsleir og Kuki-Zo-rådet advarte om strengere politiske tiltak, inkludert å trekke tilbake MP-er. Naga-rådet organiserte en stor demonstrasjon som krevde at SoO-avtalen blir avskaffet. UCDP registrerte 437 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
